description.en: Mesohippus bairdi has a shorter head than modern horse proportions and three toes on each foot, including a larger central hoof. Hair, ears, posture and dimensions are interpretive; museum mounts and skull replicas do not preserve a complete living outline.
description.zh: Mesohippus bairdi 的头部相对现代马比例较短，每足三趾，其中中央蹄较大。毛发、耳部、姿态及尺寸为解释性复原；博物馆装架与头骨复制品未保存完整活体轮廓。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original stylized Mesohippus bairdi living reconstruction guided by Carnegie CM 961 mounted skeleton photograph; supplementary AMNH replica cranium for genus-level shape. Not a specimen scan.

scientific_limits.en: Skin, hair, color, ears, posture and dimensions are reconstruction choices. Mounted bones/replicas are not exact soft-tissue outlines. Relatively short head means relative to modern horse proportions, not a round foal or tapir head.
scientific_limits.zh: 皮肤、毛、颜色、耳、姿态及尺寸是复原选择。骨架与复制品不等于精确软组织轮廓；相对短头是相对现代马的比例，并非圆幼驹头或貘头。

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: three-toed limbs and a relatively short-headed early horse build. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：三趾肢与相对短头的早期马体型。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block three-toed limbs and a relatively short-headed early horse build with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织三趾肢与相对短头的早期马体型；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; muted tan/brown, dark hoof tips; no copied image texture
frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Quiet quadrupedal stance, all four feet grounded and leg negative spaces visible. Mild head turn only; no rearing or running pose to hide toes.

scale.basis: Working artistic estimates for small early horse. No measured CM 961 dimensions available in the used sources.
scale.tolerance: Length ±10%; width and height are silhouette targets, not scientific measurements.

shape_requirements: Original combination mandatory: three-toed limbs AND relatively short-headed early horse build; not merely a modern horse scaled down.
Each of four feet has enlarged central hoof plus two smaller side toes visibly separate; no modern single hoof, no four-toed forefoot, no rhinoceros slab foot.
Compact short-muzzled equid head with meaningful cheek/jaw volume; avoid extreme modern horse elongated face, tapir trunk or rounded foal skull.
Light equid trunk, modest neck and slender articulated legs with natural elbow/knee/hock transitions, no massive rhino barrel body.
Small pointed ears and modest tail/coat are artistic soft-tissue choices; no elaborate mane or zebra pattern presented as fossil fact. Use deliberate profile loft topology.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Check front, side and elevated oblique cheaply before detail; three toes on all feet and comparatively short head must read. No extra closeups unless these cannot be assessed in normal views.
frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export views front/side/top/perspective; preview may reuse perspective. Existing technical, two isolated rebuilds and independent visual gates remain required; no extra review platform.
